note: Newest first. One entry per change to a skill or scheduled task. Written by whoever ships the change (Analyst for strategy, Architect for plumbing). Keep each field to one sentence.

changes.title: Hit rates recalibrated toward the market price
changes.change: Each rung's probability now leans 75% on a price-adjusted market estimate (bookmaker margin assumed to rise from 0% at 1.50 to about 22% at 1.95), and a pick needs at least +3pp over the break-even price instead of +5pp over a margin-free price.
changes.aim: Close the gap between the 81% hit rate the model claimed and the 56% it delivered, which should mean fewer, shorter-priced picks and 1.80+ only on near-perfect samples.

changes.title: Picks, closes and results now recorded straight to the Google Sheet
changes.change: All three tasks write the Sheet through one hash-pinned script and check the Sheet's own totals after every write; Notion and record.json are no longer written.
changes.aim: One reliable record that the dashboard and the weekly analyst review read directly, with no copying between systems.

changes.title: Safer rung on 1.80+ picks
changes.change: Every pick priced 1.80 or longer now shows the next rung down priced 1.40–1.79, with its own hit rate; display only, not logged as a pick.
changes.aim: Make a higher-hit-rate alternative visible on long prices, and track whether stepping down would have paid.

changes.title: Resolve no longer overwrites closing prices
changes.change: Close odds and CLV are now owned by the capture task; resolve only marks a still-blank close as 'no close', and runs on Melbourne time.
changes.aim: Protect the closing-line data needed to judge whether picks beat the market.

changes.title: Closing-odds capture fixed
changes.change: A parsing bug had blanked every odds response, so 91% of picks had no closing price; capture now runs hourly before tip and asks only for markets with picks.
changes.aim: Get closing-line value (CLV) on every pick — the fastest honest signal of whether the model has an edge.
